title: Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale pretraining provides embodied models with general capabilities, but reliable task execution still requires post training. In multitask settings, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) faces distribution mismatch between training and deployment, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) is limited by sparse rewards and uneven learning progress across tasks. Multi-teacher on policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates expert capabilities through dense supervision on the model's own trajectories, but achieving performance beyond the teachers remains challenging. We propose a two-stage post training framework for flow-based embodied models, constructing distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities through MOPD. translated_title: 面向基于流的具身基础模型的两阶段后训练
translated_abstract: 大规模预训练为具身模型提供了通用能力，但可靠的任务执行仍然需要后训练。在多任务设置中，监督微调（SFT）面临训练与部署之间的分布不匹配问题，而强化学习（RL）则受限于稀疏奖励以及跨任务学习进度不均衡的问题。多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）通过对模型自身轨迹的密集监督来整合专家能力，但要实现超越教师的性能仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种针对基于流的具身模型的两阶段后训练框架，从条件流匹配的速度回归形式中构建蒸馏目标。阶段1通过MOPD高效整合专家能力。阶段2将强化学习与教师蒸馏相结合，根据采样噪声对速度误差进行加权，其中蒸馏被限制在（原文在此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于流的具身基础模型的两阶段后训练框架，第一阶段通过多教师在线策略蒸馏高效整合专家能力，第二阶段将强化学习与基于采样噪声加权的教师蒸馏相结合，从而突破性能瓶颈、实现超越教师模型的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage post-training framework for flow-based embodied foundation models, where Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities via multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and Stage 2 combines RL with noise-weighted teacher distillation to achieve performance beyond the teachers.
